programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up - Night of the Flying Fist
programme.desc: Zach Calmus opens the show in a heavyweight battle with Michael Furnier, then Kyle Wright fights Pat Casey. Rounding out this hour with light heavyweights David Simpson vs Jay Jackson.

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up - Perry vs. Rockhold & More
programme.desc: Featuring exciting bare knuckle fight action as two UFC veterans duke it out, with Mike Perry fighting Luke Rockhold, Chad Mendes welcoming Eddie Alvarez to the squared circle, and Christine Ferea defending her belt against Aussie Beck Rawlings.

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up - Copeland vs. Rothwell & More
programme.desc: The best of bare knuckle fight action with Brandon Girtz vs. Christian Torres, Chris Camozzi vs. Dan Spohn, and topped off with heavyweight Josh Copeland fighting Big Ben Rothwell.

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up - Maestas vs. Winemiller & More
programme.desc: Two first time female fighters knuckle up with Khortni Kamyron vs Gabrielle Roman, then Marcus Edwards fights Action Jackson, and Mathew Maestas fights Dillon Winemiller in a crowd thriller.

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up - Loco Soto vs. Goodjohn & More
programme.desc: Exceptional bare knuckle fights between Keith Richardson and Cody Jenkins, Doug Coltrane vs. Blake Lacaze, and finishes off with a battle between Tony 'Loco' Soto vs. Tyler Goodjohn.

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up - Fast Fists Faster Fun
programme.desc: The best of bare knuckle fighting featuring Dustin Pague vs. Wade Johnson, Brandon Bushaw vs. Rick Caruso, Trevor Loken vs. Brandon Allen and finishes off with Trukon Carson vs. LJ Hermrick.

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up - Final Bell Fireworks
programme.desc: Alexandra Ballou and Taylor Dagner light the fuse in a ferocious battle where neither woman gives an inch, while Harry Gigliotti and Timmy Mason slug it out in a fan-friendly firefight. Then fan favorite Rico DiSciullo caps off the season against the dangerous Elijah Harris in a showdown built to end with fireworks.

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up - A Cruiserweight Battle in Omaha
programme.desc: A collection of battles featuring Jimmie Rivera vs. Tajikistan's Bekhzod Usmonov, Dakota Cochrane vs. Noah Cutter, and finishes things off with Houston 'The Assassin' Alexander vs. Jeremy Smith.

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up - Three Knuckle Fests Fire Up
programme.desc: Carlos Trinidad-Snake battles Elvin Brito, followed by Alonzo Martinez vs. Jeremy Sauceda in an epic battle, and wraps up with Sean Wilson vs. Brandon Meyer in a crazy knucklefest.

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up - Masson-Wong vs Starling & More
programme.desc: An exciting bare knuckle fight between Jeff Souder and Idrees Wasi opens up the show followed by Jake Masson-Wong vs Taylor Starling, and Ryan Braun challenges Andrew Potter.

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up - First Featherweight Title Fight
programme.desc: Featuring Bryce Henry vs. Billy Wagner, Lloyd Mix trades hands with Dallas Davidson, and the first ever BKFC featherweight title fight pits Kai Stewart against Louie Lopez.

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up - Four Fierce Fights
programme.desc: Fan favorite Leo Bercier opens the show against Willie Sears, followed by Dorian Long against Mark Johnson, Jordan Christensen vs. Kerry Lattimer, and Sawyer Depee takes on Gabriel Mota.

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up - Bloody Fun Night Out
programme.desc: Howard Davis takes on Eduardo Peralta, followed by Jake Bostwick in a fist fury with Erick Lozano, then Luis Palomino dukes it out with James Lilley in a BKFC lightweight title fight.

programme.title: BKFC: Knuckle Up - Norfolk Night Out

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory
